user.title: Connecting to data.mos.ru
user.description:
Paste your API key for Moscow Open Data Portal.

If you don't have one, you need active mos.ru account to [create an API key](https://data.mos.ru/developers).

data.update_interval: Data update interval (from server, in minutes)
data.show_missed: How long to display departed vehicles (in minutes)
data.newday_shift: How late does night transport operates (after midnight, in minutes)

user.title: Search for Route and Stop
user.description:
Type full roune number (ex. 123) and part of stop name.

Important: type stop name in Russian, with correct upper/lower case letters!

choice.title: Confirm Route and Stop
choice.description:
If you got several stops - check their exact location using links. You need to choose one that is on the correct side of the road:

{map_links}
